text:
incident-bot: PAGING: P1 - elevated 5xx rate for customer Cerulean Labs on Dedicated cluster ded-eu-west-2. 5xx rate 8.7% over 2m, error mix: 502 gateway, 504 timeout, backend 5xx. Links: <https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/dedicated/cerulean-5xx?orgId=1|dash>, runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood.internal/incidents/dedicated-5xx|dedicated-5xx>

oncall-alex: ack - I'm on it. grabbing logs + checking routing. tagging @eng-sre-jamie for runtime help.

eng-sre-jamie: on it. can you paste a sample request_id and the time window? also, any recent deploys to ded-eu-west-2?

cust-success-maya: Cerulean reports failures since ~11:03 UTC. sample request_id: rq_0a7f9c23. they say ~30% of API calls are returning 502 for last 5m. no deploys from our side reported by the customer.

oncall-alex: running quick tail:
```
$ redwoodctl cluster tail --cluster ded-eu-west-2 --customer cerulean --since 5m
[11:05:02] ERROR request_id=rq_0a7f9c23 status=502 handler=frontend gateway="upstream timeout"
[11:05:03] WARN queue_len=98 max_inflight=64
[11:05:04] ERROR model_dispatch failed: "runtime queue full"
[11:06:10] ERROR kvcache eviction spike: tenant=cerulean evict=2048
```

runtime-lead-ravi: looking at cluster-level metrics now. I'm seeing a sustained inflight queue for cerulean, and several nodes with CPU saturating and elevated GPU util. cluster autoscaler attempted adds but some attempts failed. suspect noisy neighbor: large concurrent batch jobs from Cerulean hitting the serving runtime and causing backpressure -> 502 gateway from proxy after handler timeouts.

infra-nik: checking node events/quotas. quick check:
```
$ gcloud compute instances list --filter="zone:(eu-west-2)" --project=redwood-prod
QuotaStatus: CPU quota 95/96, GPUs 24/24
Errors: quota exceeded for GPUs
```
we're at GPU quota in the project/region, autoscaler can't add nodes that have GPUs.

eng-sre-jamie: ok, root cause seems combo: single customer traffic pattern (large batched requests + long sequences) + KV cache thrash + GPU quota preventing scale up -> queue backs up -> proxy 502/504. immediate mitigations we can try:
- rate-limit / throttle the offending Cerulean routes
- move some Cerulean traffic to fallback cluster (ded-eu-central-1) or hosted fallback
- temporarily evict/limit noisy worker groups

oncall-alex: what's fastest to reduce customer impact? I can reroute if we agree.

runtime-lead-ravi: fastest: route Cerulean to ded-eu-central-1 (has spare capacity) for now. second option: enable hosted fallback (lower perf) for Cerulean traffic. I'll coordinate with @infra-nik for the cross-cluster move.

devops-bot: Attempting automated soft-scale (requested 3 nodes)
```
2026-03-15T11:07:20Z devops-bot: autoscaler request -> provisioning 3 gpu-n1-highmem-8
2026-03-15T11:07:45Z devops-bot: provisioning failed: QUOTA_EXCEEDED: GPUs
```

infra-nik: confirmed. quota block prevents adding GPU nodes in eu-west-2. we can open emergency quota request but won't be approved fast enough. we should re-route.

eng-sre-jamie: propose command to atomically reroute Cerulean to backup cluster (weight 100) so they stop hitting overloaded nodes:
```
# dry-run first
redwood route set --customer cerulean --from-cluster ded-eu-west-2 --to-cluster ded-eu-central-1 --weight 100 --dry-run
# execute
redwood route set --customer cerulean --to-cluster ded-eu-central-1 --weight 100
```

oncall-alex: executing reroute now. will monitor.

oncall-alex: done. reroute command returned success. applying DNS/session drain 30s.

eng-sre-jamie: watching metrics... initial check: 5xx % dropping in ded-eu-west-2 but we need to confirm ded-eu-central-1 is handling without throttling.

runtime-lead-ravi: ded-eu-central-1 shows an incoming burst but has capacity. starting to warm model caches for Cerulean's common models to avoid cold penalty.

cust-success-maya: I informed Cerulean of an active mitigation: we are routing their traffic to a nearby backup cluster. they asked for ETA for full resolution.

prod-manager-lena: ETA and impact estimate please. do we expect any data plane differences (latency, model variance)?

eng-sre-jamie: short-term ETA: traffic rerouted, 0-5m to stabilize, longer-term will need quota increase or tenant shaping. latency to backup cluster ~+40ms median, model variants identical (we verified model version pin).

oncall-alex: observing post-reroute metrics: ded-eu-west-2 5xx dropped from 8.7% -> 1.1% within 2m. ded-eu-central-1 5xx at 0.9%. overall customer errors trending down.

cust-success-maya: Cerulean confirms errors decreased on their end. they are seeing successful calls now. :thumbsup:

runtime-lead-ravi: follow-ups (action items):
- infra: open emergency GPU quota request and escalate to cloud ops (nik)
- eng-sre: add tenant-level soft limits + better batching guidance (jamie)
- product: review SLA/handbook for fallback flows (lena)
- runbook: add explicit noisy-tenant checklist and cross-cluster reroute steps

infra-nik: opened ticket with cloud support: INC-99341, marked high priority. also will temporarily free up 2 GPUs by moving non-critical batch jobs out of eu-west-2.

devops-bot: freed 2 GPUs from low-priority batch pool at 11:22 UTC.

eng-sre-jamie: quick mitigation we applied: increased per-tenant max_inflight from 64 -> 80 for Cerulean to smooth draining, and added a short token-bucket limit for large batch endpoints. Will follow with a config PR for permanent guardrails.

oncall-alex: marking incident as mitigated. will keep channel open for follow-up until tickets closed. closing page but not the thread.

prod-manager-lena: please create post-incident follow-up doc in #postmortems and assign owners. want root cause analysis within 48h.

cust-success-maya: I'll update Cerulean with a short postmortem and timeline, and offer them a support call.

eng-sre-jamie: notes for postmortem: noisy tenant large-batch pattern + kv cache eviction + gpu quota hit -> queue overload -> proxy 502/504. mitigations worked: cross-cluster reroute + short-term throttle + increase inflight + freeing low-priority GPUs. planned next steps: quota request, tenant throttles, improved monitoring for per-tenant queue length.

oncall-alex: thanks everyone. tagging this as resolved for the on-call rotation. if any regression ping me directly.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated: P1 -> escalated to follow-ups. runbook link and ticket references posted above.

eng-sre-jamie: thumbs up. filing PR for tenant soft-limits now. :white_check_mark:

infra-nik: will post quota ticket updates here.

cust-success-maya: I'll send customer note in 10m.

oncall-alex: end of thread for paging."
